description: This PHP file defines the Vtiger_Event class, which provides an API to manage and trigger CRM events within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for registering event handlers, triggering events, and retrieving registered events, as well as internal support checks and logging functionality.

classes.name: Vtiger_Event
classes.description: Provides API to work with vtiger CRM event handling, including registration, triggering, and retrieval of events.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Helper function to log messages, used internally for debugging and information.

methods.name: hasSupport
methods.description: Checks whether the vtiger CRM system supports event handling by verifying the existence of the 'vtiger_eventhandlers' table.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific module, event, handler class, and associated file, with optional conditions.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers a specific event for a CRM record, invoking associated event handlers if supported and applicable.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all registered events for a given module instance.
